content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Wichita

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires either a four-year degree plus three years of project-management experience, or a high-school diploma plus five years of experience. Review PMI's full eligibility criteria to ensure you meet education and hours requirements before enrolling in training.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP course. Attend all sessions synchronously with active certified practitioners, ask questions in real time, and receive your official completion certificate—the formal education credential PMI requires for application.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: Register with PMI, report your project-management experience, upload your training completion certificate, and pay the exam fee directly to PMI. Verify all details are accurate before submitting; PMI will audit your application for compliance.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources, practice tests, and review sessions to build confidence. Schedule your computerized exam through PMI's testing partner, then take the exam at an approved test center in or near Wichita.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: Earn Professional Development Units (PDUs) over a three-year renewal cycle by attending training, publishing, or volunteering in project-management roles. Renew with PMI before your credential expires to keep your PMP active and demonstrate ongoing competency.

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI requires either a four-year degree with 36 months of project leadership experience, or a high school diploma with 60 months of experience. All applicants need 35 contact hours of PM education — our course satisfies this requirement.
